0022600214.text: The Utah Jazz (1-9, 15th in the West, on an eight-game losing streak) host the Miami Heat (4-6, 8th in the East, coming off a win) in the Jazz's 11th game of the 2026-27 season. Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) are out for Utah, while Keyonte George (ankle) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Miami's Giannis Antetokounmpo (wrist sprain) is also day-to-day and a game-time decision, and the teams have yet to meet this season after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, with Utah winning the last meeting 115-111 in Miami on February 9, 2026.
